Sometime during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|era]] of conflicts between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Porus Vida]] was '''subjugated''' by a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] hired by the corrupt government of the nearby world of [[Norulac]]. Led by the psychotic mass-[[Death/Legends|murderer]] [[Lunatta]], the mercenaries invaded and conquered the peaceful Porus Vida, forcing it to surrender. As payment, Norulac permitted Lunatta to loot an [[Porus Vida art museum|art museum]] on Porus Vida; she took several hand-woven tapestries to adorn her personal [[Warship/Legends|warship]] and burned everything else in the museum.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The subjugation of Porus Vida was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', published as a tie-in to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
